# Vanguard Standing Orders
How the [color=tan]Vanguard[/color] is expected to act around the TSF. Ignoring these may get you punished by your superiors.
[color=red]OOC Note: These orders are In Character only and will not be punished by admins short of breaking the actual OOC rules. You may follow or disobey them of your own free will, but you may face IC punishments from your superiors.[/color]
## During the ceasefire (WAR LEVEL: COLD)
1. Do not start the war yourself. That is the [color=purple]Grand Vizier[/color]'s call.
2. Stay away from TSF ships. If one gets close, hail it and tell it to back off. If it doesn't, leave and report it.
3. Only shoot if you are shot at or boarded, or if a ship ignores a warning to leave Helios or the Jupiter. Stop when they leave.
4. Event POIs, our drop pods and Monolithic Fragments are contested. You can fight the TSF there, but do not chase them once they leave.
5. Smuggling, dead drops and spying are how we fight the rest of the time. Do not get caught.
6. If the TSF captures one of ours, tell the [color=yellow]Asvaran[/color] or the [color=purple]Grand Vizier[/color]. Do not raid Halcyon over it.
7. Leave civilians alone. They move our crates.
8. Heretics are still hunted as usual.
## During war (WAR LEVEL: HOT)
1. TSF ships and marines can be attacked anywhere, and Halcyon can be struck.
2. If a ceasefire is announced, stop fighting and head back.
